WITH min_cost_suppliers AS (
  SELECT 
    ps.ps_suppkey,
    ps.ps_partkey,
    MIN(ps.ps_supplycost) AS min_cost
  FROM partsupp ps
  JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey
  JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
  JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
  JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
  WHERE p.p_size = 15
    AND p.p_type LIKE '%BRASS%'
    AND r.r_name = 'EUROPE'
  GROUP BY ps.ps_suppkey, ps.ps_partkey
)

  s.s_acctbal,
  s.s_name,
  n.n_name,
  p.p_partkey,
  p.p_mfgr,
  s.s_address,
  s.s_phone,
  s.s_comment
FROM min_cost_suppliers mc
JOIN supplier s ON mc.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN part p ON mc.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey
ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC, n.n_name, s.s_name, p.p_partkey

SELECT
  (SUM(CASE WHEN p_type LIKE 'PROMO%' THEN l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) /
  SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS promo_revenue
FROM lineitem
JOIN part ON lineitem.l_partkey = part.p_partkey
WHERE lineitem.l_shipdate >= '1995-09-01'
  AND lineitem.l_shipdate < '1995-10-01'

results.sql:
SELECT
    n.n_name AS supp_nation,
    n2.n_name AS cust_nation,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.l_shipdate) AS l_year,
    SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue
FROM lineitem l
JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN nation n2 ON c.c_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey
WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1996-12-31'
  AND (n.n_name = 'FRANCE' AND n2.n_name = 'GERMANY')
  OR (n.n_name = 'GERMANY' AND n2.n_name = 'FRANCE')
GROUP BY supp_nation, cust_nation, l_year
ORDER BY supp_nation, cust_nation, l_year
